lead: Sign in with your owner account.
wrong: The email or password is wrong.
throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {{s}} seconds.

locked.title: Locked after 15 minutes idle
locked.body: Sign in again to continue where you left off.

down.title: Can’t reach Atlas at localhost:8000
down.body: Start it with ./atlas up in Terminal, then try again.

first.title: Create the owner account first
first.body: Atlas has no owner account yet. In Terminal, inside the Atlas folder, run:
first.after: It asks for your name, email and a password. Then check again here.

tf.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
tf.leadRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved.
tf.useApp: Use a code from your app instead
tf.lost: Lost your phone and your codes?
tf.lostBody: On this Mac, open Terminal in the Atlas folder and run:
tf.lostAfter: It asks for your password, then turns two-factor sign-in off. Sign in with your password, then turn it on again in Settings → General.
tf.codeWrong: That code didn’t work. Type the code your app shows now.
tf.recoveryWrong: That recovery code didn’t work. It may have been used already.

expired.title: Sign-in timed out
expired.body: The code has to follow your password within 5 minutes. Enter your password again.

tf.many: Too many tries. Try again in {{s}} seconds.
tf.toast: Signed in with a recovery code
tf.toastBody: {{n}} of 8 codes left. Make new ones in Settings → General.
tf.toastNone: That was your last code. Make new ones in Settings → General.
